content: {"praised":["James Spader delivers compelling, charismatic performance as Red Reddington.","Show is well written and well plotted.","Original twist on FBI consultant theme.","Strong acting and casting throughout.","Engaging, slick, and engrossing tone."],"criticized":["Story feels unrealistic and repetitive.","Supporting cast is dreadful and unwatchable.","Episodes drag and become boring.","Unbelievable scenarios, like dirty bomb plot.","Propaganda-like themes, promoting police state."]}
